articles.summary: A ketogenic diet outperformed Mediterranean and low-fat diets in several measures of metabolic health during a clinical trial involving people with obesity, prediabetes, and fatty liver disease. articles.summary: Beneath the rocky slopes of Mount Timpanogos lies far more ice than anyone walking across the surface might suspect. Similar formations around the world may collectively store tens of gigatons of hidden water.
